question: What ritual action with a tilaka produces delusion of the world?
premises: A forehead mark is employed in the rite.
The mantra is to be performed sevenfold.
The intended effect is delusion of the world.
inference: One should perform the mantra sevenfold with a tilaka to delude the world.
plain_english: With a tilaka, one should perform the mantra sevenfold to delude the world.
